heading: HUL Interim Dividend 2026: What Investors Need to Know
tldr: Hindustan Unilever (HUL) has declared an interim dividend of ₹19 per equity share for 2026.
This payout represents 1,900% of the company's face value of ₹1 per share.
To be eligible for this dividend, investors must have purchased HUL shares before the ex-dividend date.
The record date determines which shareholders are entitled to receive the dividend payment.
Dividends are subject to income tax in India, depending on the individual's tax slab.
caption:
Thinking about investing in companies like HUL? Good news! HUL just announced a ₹19 dividend for each share in 2026. This means if you own HUL shares by a certain date, you get a small payout.
